TerrainDef.Name: WA_Seat_TatamiBase
TerrainDef.description: Tatami is called Straw mats and is laid on the floor of a Japanese style room. It has been used since ancient times during the Heian period, and has long been loved as a culture unique to Japan.Originally green and yellow were often used, but in recent years tatami of various colors was created and gaining popularity.
